components.label: Active ingredient
components.quote: Live, attenuated, recombinant Japanese encephalitis virus*: 4.0 - 5.8 log PFU**

components.label: No adjuvant/preservative
components.quote: No adjuvant or antimicrobial preservative is added.

allergens.quote: No adjuvant or antimicrobial preservative is added.
No adjuvant or antimicrobial preservative is added.
allergens.note: 仿單另於6.5節提及「flip off cap (aluminium/polypropylene)」，惟該處aluminium係指安瓿瓶翻蓋瓶蓋材質，屬包裝容器組件，非疫苗成分或佐劑，不影響本欄「無」佐劑之判定

warnings.label: 禁忌
warnings.quote:
Imojev should not be administered to anyone with a history of severe allergic reaction to any
component of the vaccine or after previous administration of the vaccine or a vaccine
containing the same components or constituents.

warnings.label: 禁忌－免疫缺陷
warnings.quote:
Congenital or acquired immune deficiency impairing cellular immunity, including
immunosuppressive therapies such as chemotherapy, high doses of systemic corticosteroids
given for 14 days or more.

warnings.label: 禁忌－懷孕／哺乳
warnings.quote:
Imojev must not be administered to pregnant women (see Section 4.6 Fertility, pregnancy and
lactation - Use in pregnancy).

dismissed.egg: p.4「embryo-foetal development」出自兔隻生殖毒性試驗段落（母兔孕期胚胎發育），與蛋／雞胚培養或卵蛋白過敏原無關，非假陽性外之真實命中
